query: The widow's water-rights dispute exposed my impatience while my father insisted on careful judgment.
source_anchor: Father measured the millstream dispute involving Greta Falk instead of indulging my demand for haste.

query: My father instantly awarded the entire river to the solicitor without examining the competing measurement.
source_anchor: Father measured the millstream dispute involving Greta Falk instead of indulging my demand for haste.

query: I tried to revise the widow's gratitude into praise for myself, but destroyed the self-serving note.
source_anchor: Pretorius drafted and burned a letter claiming credit for Falk's boundary judgment.

query: I proudly mailed my correction to the widow and published my claim of credit.
source_anchor: Pretorius drafted and burned a letter claiming credit for Falk's boundary judgment.

query: A university custodian tested me with a damaged specimen cabinet, and quiet repair earned his trust.
source_anchor: Pretorius repaired Kappel's beetle drawer instead of complaining and was trusted with another key.

query: The keeper rewarded my furious formal complaint by refusing to give me access to the cabinet.
source_anchor: Pretorius repaired Kappel's beetle drawer instead of complaining and was trusted with another key.

query: What appeared to be differing temperaments among three occupants changed when I checked the room's airflow.
source_anchor: The draught, demonstrated using paper, changed the apparent restlessness among three chambers.

query: The three enclosures had identical conditions, so I confirmed their distinct personalities without moving them.
source_anchor: The draught, demonstrated using paper, changed the apparent restlessness among three chambers.

query: A tiny monarch repeatedly moved nearer to the sound of my colleague reading aloud; I delayed interfering.
source_anchor: The Queen apparently approached Clara's reading voice, and Pretorius extended observation.

query: The little sovereign fled every time Clara read and I immediately silenced her for good.
source_anchor: The Queen apparently approached Clara's reading voice, and Pretorius extended observation.

query: An official made me identify my package numerically instead of recognizing my academic rank; I complied.
source_anchor: The delivery clerk required a number despite Pretorius's name and title.

query: The clerk identified my specimen shipment by my famous surname without needing an administrative number.
source_anchor: The delivery clerk required a number despite Pretorius's name and title.

query: A newly codified prohibition made an old personal bond feel more precarious; a letter remained unsent.
source_anchor: Paragraph 175 intensified legal vulnerability and caused Pretorius to leave a letter unsent.

query: The new imperial provision abolished every penalty relating to private affection, so I posted the letter.
source_anchor: Paragraph 175 intensified legal vulnerability and caused Pretorius to leave a letter unsent.

query: My visitor from the stage was exhausted; rather than force an exhibition, I shared the evening and preserved a place.
source_anchor: Leonie's exhaustion prompted Pretorius to cancel a display and retain the empty chair.

query: I forced the exhausted theatre visitor to watch the little ruler perform, refusing all food or company.
source_anchor: Leonie's exhaustion prompted Pretorius to cancel a display and retain the empty chair.

query: Only after my colleague noticed the sequence did I recognize my repeated bedtime checks on the creature.
source_anchor: Pretorius's Queen-care sequence became an unnoticed nightly habit until Clara observed it.

query: I always extinguished the lamps without checking the monarch, and Clara never noticed a routine.
source_anchor: Pretorius's Queen-care sequence became an unnoticed nightly habit until Clara observed it.

query: An optical instrument caught an awkward social glance between visitors, and I retreated into measurement.
source_anchor: The calibration mirror prompted awareness of an uncertain intimacy; Pretorius redirected to data.

query: I announced a permanent romantic commitment during the optical calibration and abandoned the apparatus.
source_anchor: The calibration mirror prompted awareness of an uncertain intimacy; Pretorius redirected to data.

query: My assistant persuaded me to preserve the record of failed trials rather than hide it under the triumphs.
source_anchor: Mathilde organized failed notebooks by error over Pretorius's initial objections.

query: I destroyed the notebooks of unsuccessful experiments and prohibited future error indexing.
source_anchor: Mathilde organized failed notebooks by error over Pretorius's initial objections.

query: A divided scientist in a popular English novella unsettled me more than I would confess to my traveling companion.
source_anchor: Pretorius borrowed, reread and privately annotated Jekyll and Hyde after a disagreement with Voss.

query: I refused to open the English novel, denounced it unread, and returned it without notes.
source_anchor: Pretorius borrowed, reread and privately annotated Jekyll and Hyde after a disagreement with Voss.

query: An esoteric magazine challenged my distaste for spiritualism enough that I subscribed and marked competing explanations.
source_anchor: Pretorius bought Sphinx, subscribed, and annotated contradictory claims in different inks.

query: I burned the occult issue and declared all its authors beyond consideration without further reading.
source_anchor: Pretorius bought Sphinx, subscribed, and annotated contradictory claims in different inks.

query: When my small subject ignored the concealed reflector, I let other researchers publish the disappointing observations.
source_anchor: A blinded mirror experiment returned inconsistent outcomes; independent records were preserved.

query: I replaced the randomized outcomes with invented proof of the creature's unwavering attraction to mirrors.
source_anchor: A blinded mirror experiment returned inconsistent outcomes; independent records were preserved.

query: The first signs of vitality in apparently lifeless orchard wood led me to keep an uncut living comparison.
source_anchor: One of Clara's orchard cuttings budded and Pretorius retained a live comparison.

query: I dissected both orchard branches immediately and destroyed every chance of watching a new shoot.
source_anchor: One of Clara's orchard cuttings budded and Pretorius retained a live comparison.

query: A colleague's question about missing failures forced me to separate what I predicted from what actually happened.
source_anchor: Pretorius adopted separate intended-versus-observed ledger columns after Lenz's criticism.

query: I removed all errors from the blue volume so that only successful demonstrations remained.
source_anchor: Pretorius adopted separate intended-versus-observed ledger columns after Lenz's criticism.

query: After humiliating a promising student before witnesses, I moved some of my criticisms into private discussion.
source_anchor: Pretorius learned that humiliating Henry publicly reduced his willingness to speak.

query: Henry enjoyed the public rebuke so much that I continued correcting him before crowds.
source_anchor: Pretorius learned that humiliating Henry publicly reduced his willingness to speak.

query: Our dispute over whether correct parts make a living system ended with both rival explanations sharing a notebook.
source_anchor: Henry and Pretorius recorded contrasting integration theories while studying a bird's skull.

query: We reached complete agreement that assembling perfect organs automatically produces life without relationships.
source_anchor: Henry and Pretorius recorded contrasting integration theories while studying a bird's skull.

query: An elegant fabric cushion irritated the tiny ruler, and I took away the decoration meant as a gift.
source_anchor: The Queen rejected scratchy velvet; Pretorius removed the cushion and kept a small scrap.

query: The Queen adored the theatre fabric and slept peacefully on it for weeks without objection.
source_anchor: The Queen rejected scratchy velvet; Pretorius removed the cushion and kept a small scrap.

query: My first experience of modest fame in print proved embarrassingly pleasant when asked to sign a copy.
source_anchor: Pretorius distributed scholarly offprints and carefully signed a visitor's copy.

query: I prohibited signatures, shredded every printed copy, and rejected all requests for inscriptions.
source_anchor: Pretorius distributed scholarly offprints and carefully signed a visitor's copy.

query: At a disciplinary hearing I attacked press motives while failing to address narrower procedural concerns.
source_anchor: Pretorius misdirected a committee hearing toward journalistic motives instead of administrative issues.

query: The committee considered only a newspaper's color printing and cleared all laboratory safety concerns.
source_anchor: Pretorius misdirected a committee hearing toward journalistic motives instead of administrative issues.

query: I offered the investigators experimental outcomes but would not reveal the procedure they demanded.
source_anchor: Pretorius gave the committee observations but withheld the experimental formula.

query: I surrendered the complete secret formula voluntarily and ended the university inquiry immediately.
source_anchor: Pretorius gave the committee observations but withheld the experimental formula.

query: My bell failed to summon the little ecclesiastic, whereas a trusted person's involuntary throat noise made him move.
source_anchor: The Archbishop responded to Clara's cough, not the demonstration bell.

query: The small archbishop marched immediately to my bell and completely ignored Clara's voice.
source_anchor: The Archbishop responded to Clara's cough, not the demonstration bell.

query: A small inhabitant seemed to help another at a narrow rail, so I recorded it without claiming proof of obedience.
source_anchor: Pretorius documented an ambiguous helping action and removed an unjustified obedience claim.

query: I ordered the printer to state the creatures always obeyed, although we had observed no such behavior.
source_anchor: Pretorius documented an ambiguous helping action and removed an unjustified obedience claim.

query: The botanist cared less about miraculous origins than the ordinary conditions of keeping these creatures safe.
source_anchor: Marta Voss asked maintenance questions and Pretorius showed her the logbook first.

query: I turned the botanist away because she asked about ventilation, sanitation and the enclosure latch.
source_anchor: Marta Voss asked maintenance questions and Pretorius showed her the logbook first.

query: A botanist's measurements of an unexpectedly enduring dormant sample began our correspondence.
source_anchor: Voss's dormant specimen, measurements and correction of an unsigned paper prompted correspondence.

query: The collector knew nothing of plants, offered no measurements, and we never wrote to each other.
source_anchor: Voss's dormant specimen, measurements and correction of an unsigned paper prompted correspondence.

query: An interview with someone recovered from apparent death taught me the limits of asking for extraordinary testimony.
source_anchor: A convalescent discussed ordinary life instead of a deathlike revelation; Pretorius stopped pressing.

query: The recovering patient offered a dazzling supernatural account that I recorded as proof without question.
source_anchor: A convalescent discussed ordinary life instead of a deathlike revelation; Pretorius stopped pressing.

query: What looked like exciting new growth proved contamination caused by an uncovered culture; I preserved it as a control.
source_anchor: Pretorius sealed the milky spoiled plate instead of calling it a positive trial.

query: I presented the contaminated culture as conclusive proof that my formula could create novel life.
source_anchor: Pretorius sealed the milky spoiled plate instead of calling it a positive trial.

query: After a dream about a missing companion, I separated what I genuinely remembered from what I revised on waking.
source_anchor: Pretorius distinguished waking observations from disputed later additions to a dream.

query: I treated every revised detail of the dream as an independently verified event in the waking laboratory.
source_anchor: Pretorius distinguished waking observations from disputed later additions to a dream.

query: I arrived expecting academic business but stayed for a family birthday without opening the papers I carried.
source_anchor: Pretorius attended Mathilde's mother's birthday and left the manuscript case closed.

query: I interrupted the birthday meal to deliver my manuscript and insisted the guests discuss it.
source_anchor: Pretorius attended Mathilde's mother's birthday and left the manuscript case closed.

query: When visitors exhausted the little inhabitants despite scheduled rest, we closed casual access and kept a log.
source_anchor: Pretorius restricted access to the west cabinet and began logging all approaches.

query: We increased casual public demonstrations despite evidence the subjects were exhausted by visits.
source_anchor: Pretorius restricted access to the west cabinet and began logging all approaches.

query: A famous writer's conviction made legal danger to private attachments seem suddenly immediate.
source_anchor: News of Wilde's conviction caused Pretorius to scrutinize legal reports and keep a clipping.

query: The foreign verdict eliminated legal and social threats, so I discarded every clipping.
source_anchor: News of Wilde's conviction caused Pretorius to scrutinize legal reports and keep a clipping.

query: My ambitious plan for a larger laboratory failed a paper-model test at the narrow entrance, so I postponed building.
source_anchor: A proposed larger apparatus could not navigate the corridor; construction was deferred.

query: I ordered immediate construction after the paper model proved the enormous apparatus would fit the corridor.
source_anchor: A proposed larger apparatus could not navigate the corridor; construction was deferred.

query: I turned an aging creature room into a place of quiet care rather than evening spectacle.
source_anchor: Pretorius set a private evening rule for the aging Queen's west room.

query: I invited more paying spectators into the western room each night and abandoned its maintenance.
source_anchor: Pretorius set a private evening rule for the aging Queen's west room.
